```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(dlm)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.pos = "H", fig.align = "center", out.extra = "", fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3, out.width = "67%")

set_theme(theme_classic())

```

```{r Implementation}
df <- read.csv("gistemp.csv", skip = 1, na.strings = "***")
monthly_matrix <- as.matrix(df[, 2:13])
monthly_vector <- as.numeric(t(monthly_matrix))

gistemp_ts_raw <- ts(monthly_vector, start = c(1880, 1), frequency = 12)

# Eliminating seasonality
stl_decomp <- stl(gistemp_ts_raw, s.window = "periodic")
gistemp_ts <- gistemp_ts_raw - stl_decomp$time.series[,"seasonal"]

```

# Dynamic linear models

```{r rw and llt}
print(1)
```

# Parameter estimation

```{r params estimation}
# builder functions
build_rw <- function(params) {
  dlmModPoly(order = 1, dV = params[1], dW = params[2])
}
build_llt <- function(params) {
  dlmModPoly(order = 2, dV = params[1], dW = c(params[2], params[3]))
}
set.seed(88888)
start_rw <- c(1,1)
start_llt <- c(1,1,1)

# ML estimation - rw
mle_rw <- dlmMLE(gistemp_ts,
                  parm = start_rw,
                  build = build_rw,
                  hessian = TRUE
                  )
# output - rw
sigma2_rw <- mle_rw$par[1]
tau2_rw <- mle_rw$par[2]
se_rw <- sqrt(diag(solve(mle_rw$hessian)))

# - llt
mle_llt <- dlmMLE(gistemp_ts,
       parm = start_llt,
       build = build_llt,
       hessian = TRUE
       )

# output - llt
sigma2_llt <- mle_llt$par[1]
tau2_llt <- mle_llt$par[2]
gamma2_llt <- mle_llt$par[3]
se_llt <- sqrt(diag(solve(mle_llt$hessian)))

mle_table <- data.frame(
  Model     = c("RW", "RW", "LLT", "LLT", "LLT"),
  Parameter = c("sigma^2", "tau^2", "sigma^2", "tau^2", "gamma^2"),
  MLE       = c(sigma2_rw, tau2_rw, sigma2_llt, tau2_llt, gamma2_llt),
  SE        = c(se_rw, se_llt)
)
knitr::kable(mle_table, digits = 6, caption = "MLE estimates and asymptotic standard errors")
```

# Filtering and smoothing

```{r}
# note that the following are the fitted models:
mod_rw  <- build_rw(mle_rw$par)
mod_llt <- build_llt(mle_llt$par)
```

# Forecasting, model checking and model evaluation

```{r forecasting}

# Split dataset
max_date <- max(time(gistemp_ts))
training_date <- max_date - 20

gistemp_ts_train <- window(gistemp_ts, end = training_date)
gistemp_ts_test <- window(gistemp_ts, start = training_date + 1/frequency(gistemp_ts))

# Train models

set.seed(88888)

# Redo builders with log-variances

build_rw_train <- function(params) {
  dlmModPoly(order = 1, dV = exp(params[1]), dW = exp(params[2]))
}
build_llt_train <- function(params) {
  dlmModPoly(order = 2, dV = exp(params[1]), dW = c(exp(params[2]), exp(params[3])))
}

# ML estimation - rw
mle_rw_train <- dlmMLE(gistemp_ts_train,
                  parm = c(0, 0),
                  build = build_rw_train,
                  hessian = TRUE
                  )
# output - rw
sigma2_rw_train <- exp(mle_rw_train$par[1])
tau2_rw_train <- exp(mle_rw_train$par[2])

# - llt
mle_llt_train <- dlmMLE(gistemp_ts_train,
       parm = c(0, 0, 0),
       build = build_llt_train,
       hessian = TRUE
       )

# output - llt
sigma2_llt_train <- exp(mle_llt_train$par[1])
tau2_llt_train <- exp(mle_llt_train$par[2])
gamma2_llt_train <- exp(mle_llt_train$par[3])

mle_table_train <- data.frame(
  Model     = c("RW", "RW", "LLT", "LLT", "LLT"),
  Parameter = c("sigma^2", "tau^2", "sigma^2", "tau^2", "gamma^2"),
  MLE       = c(sigma2_rw_train, tau2_rw_train, sigma2_llt_train, tau2_llt_train, gamma2_llt_train)
)
knitr::kable(mle_table_train, digits = 6, caption = "MLE estimates (training sample)")

# filters & forecast errors

mod_rw_train  <- dlmFilter(gistemp_ts, build_rw_train(mle_rw_train$par))
mod_llt_train <- dlmFilter(gistemp_ts, build_llt_train(mle_llt_train$par))

gistemp_frcst_rw <- gistemp_ts_test - window(mod_rw_train$f, start = training_date + 1/frequency(gistemp_ts))
gistemp_frcst_rw_std <- window(residuals(mod_rw_train, sd = FALSE), start = training_date + 1/frequency(gistemp_ts))

gistemp_frcst_llt <- gistemp_ts_test - window(mod_llt_train$f, start = training_date + 1/frequency(gistemp_ts))
gistemp_frcst_llt_std <- window(residuals(mod_llt_train, sd = FALSE), start = training_date + 1/frequency(gistemp_ts))

# Model checking
acf(gistemp_frcst_rw_std)
acf(gistemp_frcst_llt_std)

qqnorm(gistemp_frcst_rw_std)
qqline(gistemp_frcst_rw_std)

qqnorm(gistemp_frcst_llt_std)
qqline(gistemp_frcst_llt_std)

# RMSE
rmse_rw <- sqrt(mean(gistemp_frcst_rw^2))
rmse_llt <- sqrt(mean(gistemp_frcst_llt^2))

rmse_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("RW", "LLT"),
  RMSE = c(rmse_rw, rmse_llt)
)

knitr::kable(rmse_table, digits = 6, caption = "Test-set RMSE")

# Interpretation

# Both models have effectively the same test-set RMSE (LLT is negligibly smaller RW).
# Moreover, the variance for the estimated slope innovation is essentially zero,
# which suggests that the data do not support a time-varying slope component.
# Therefore, the LLT model does not provide a meaningful improvement over the more
# parsimonious RW model.

```
